path: *Life on the Edge* — the big picture, in a weekend.
Hore & Mouritsen (2016), then Rodgers & Hore (2009) — the radical-pair mechanism properly.
Kim et al. (2021) and Cao et al. (2020) — the state of the whole field.
Breuer & Petruccione, chapters 3–4 — the open-quantum-systems tools you will actually use.
Then the Biological qubits section of the Atlas.

items.title: Life on the Edge: The Coming of Age of Quantum Biology
items.why: Readable tour of tunnelling, photosynthesis, the avian compass and more. The best first book.

items.title: Quantum Effects in Biology
items.authors: M. Mohseni, Y. Omar, G. S. Engel & M. B. Plenio (eds.)
items.why: Graduate-level edited volume; chapters on radical pairs, energy transfer and decoherence by the people who did the work.

items.title: What Is Life?
items.why: The historical starting point the field still quotes.

items.title: Introduction to Dynamic Spin Chemistry
items.why: Compact textbook on radical-pair spin dynamics and magnetic field effects, including biochemical reactions.

items.title: Principles of Pulse Electron Paramagnetic Resonance
items.why: The reference for spin Hamiltonians and pulse sequences — essential for ODMR-type protein-qubit work.

items.title: Electron Paramagnetic Resonance: Elementary Theory and Practical Applications
items.authors: J. A. Weil & J. R. Bolton
items.why: Gentler EPR introduction; good for hyperfine and g-tensor basics.

items.title: Spin Dynamics: Basics of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
items.why: Spin operators, density matrices and relaxation, directly reusable for radical pairs and nuclear-spin problems.

items.title: The Theory of Open Quantum Systems
items.why: Master equations, Lindblad and Redfield theory, decoherence — the core for any ‘does coherence survive in a protein?’ question.

items.title: Quantum Computation and Quantum Information
items.authors: M. A. Nielsen & I. L. Chuang
items.why: Qubits, gates, fidelity and entanglement — the language protein-qubit papers borrow.

items.title: Quantum Dissipative Systems
items.why: Spin–boson model and system–bath theory in depth.

reviews.cite: P. J. Hore & H. Mouritsen, Annu. Rev. Biophys. 45, 299–344 (2016)
reviews.title: The radical-pair mechanism of magnetoreception
reviews.why: The standard review of the avian compass.

reviews.cite: C. T. Rodgers & P. J. Hore, PNAS 106, 353–360 (2009)
reviews.title: Chemical magnetoreception in birds: the radical pair mechanism
reviews.why: Clear physical introduction to radical-pair magnetosensitivity.

reviews.cite: T. Ritz, S. Adem & K. Schulten, Biophys. J. 78, 707–718 (2000)
reviews.title: A model for photoreceptor-based magnetoreception in birds
reviews.why: Proposed cryptochrome as the compass molecule.

reviews.cite: K. Schulten, C. E. Swenberg & A. Weller, Z. Phys. Chem. NF 111, 1–5 (1978)
reviews.title: A biomagnetic sensory mechanism based on magnetic field modulated coherent electron spin motion
reviews.why: Where the radical-pair compass idea began.

reviews.cite: U. E. Steiner & T. Ulrich, Chem. Rev. 89, 51–147 (1989)
reviews.title: Magnetic field effects in chemical kinetics and related phenomena
Chemical compass model of avian magnetoreception
reviews.why: First demonstration that a molecule can sense the direction of an Earth-strength field.

reviews.cite: N. Lambert et al., Nat. Phys. 9, 10–18 (2013)
reviews.title: Quantum biology

reviews.cite: J. Cao et al., Sci. Adv. 6, eaaz4888 (2020)
reviews.title: Quantum biology revisited
reviews.why: Critical reassessment of what is and isn't established.

reviews.cite: Y. Kim et al., Quantum Rep. 3, 80–126 (2021)
reviews.title: Quantum biology: an update and perspective
reviews.why: Broad open-access survey: enzymes, photosynthesis, spins, DNA, fluorescent proteins.

reviews.cite: I. K. Kominis, Phys. Rev. E 80, 056115 (2009)
reviews.title: Quantum Zeno effect explains magnetic-sensitive radical-ion-pair reactions
reviews.why: The open-quantum-systems view of radical-pair recombination.

software.name: RadicalPy
software.what: Object-oriented Python framework for radical-pair spin dynamics: Hamiltonians, relaxation, kinetics, MARY curves. pip install radicalpy

software.name: MolSpin
software.what: General spin-dynamics package from the Solov'yov group, for large radical-pair systems. Nielsen & Solov'yov, J. Chem. Phys. 151, 194105 (2019).

software.name: EasySpin
software.what: MATLAB toolbox for simulating EPR spectra; the field standard. Stoll & Schweiger, J. Magn. Reson. 178, 42–55 (2006).

software.name: QuTiP
software.what: Python toolbox for open quantum systems: master equations, trajectories, pulse control. Johansson, Nation & Nori, Comput. Phys. Commun. 184, 1234 (2013).

software.name: ORCA
software.what: Quantum-chemistry package widely used for hyperfine and g-tensors of flavin and tryptophan radicals.

community.name: Quantum Biology Institute
community.what: Research and community organisation co-founded by C. D. Aiello.

community.name: Leverhulme Quantum Biology Doctoral Training Centre
community.what: University of Surrey doctoral centre behind the Kim et al. (2021) review.

community.what: Discord community run by the RadicalPy developers (invite on their page).
